items.name: Wild/red rice salad with corn and diced vegetables
items.preparation: cooked grain salad, scattered over the greens and beside the beef

items.name: Tofu cube with herbs (could be white fish or feta)
Vinaigrette / olive oil dressing
items.preparation: dressing implied by the glossy greens and grain salad

scale_cues: White square dinner plate about 26–27 cm across, fork tines visible at the top-left edge; I compared each item's footprint and height to the plate size.
assumptions: Lean beef at about 200 kcal and 29 g protein per 100 g cooked
The white herb-topped block is treated as firm tofu (about 120 kcal and 12 g protein per 100 g). If it is fish, protein goes up a little. If it is feta, kcal goes up by about 70.
Grain salad at about 110 kcal per 100 g with a little oil included
About 7 g of oil-based dressing across the salad
The small apple or pear piece near the tofu weighs under 5 g, so it is not counted as a separate item
